name: STUDIO
title: Prompt pack 1: studio and lifestyle portrait (the current wording)
summary: The wording in use on 18 Nov 2026. Try On is the AR-iMac 2.1 studio prompt, word for word. Style is the LK2.0 app's StylePrompt.scene / StylePrompt.look as described in the developer's walkthrough of 18 Nov. To revert from any other pack, switch back to PP1.

tryon.task: Create a studio catalog portrait of this customer wearing exactly this eyewear.
tryon.shot: Shot: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait. {pose_line} Relaxed neutral expression, eyes looking into the lens, plain dark grey crew-neck T-shirt. Seamless pure white studio background. Soft, even, diffused front lighting. 85 mm lens at eye level, sharp focus on the eyes, the frame and the temple arm.
tryon.render: Render it as an unretouched photograph of a real person, with natural skin texture.

scene.task: Create a candid lifestyle photograph of this customer {scene}.{custom}
scene.shot: Shot: vertical portrait from the chest up, the face large and in the upper third of the picture, with a calm, uncluttered area above the head. 50 mm lens, shallow depth of field, {light}.
scene.render: Render it as an unretouched photograph of a real person, with natural skin texture.

look.render: Keep it an unretouched photograph of a real person, with natural skin texture.

work.scene: at a desk in a bright, modern office in the morning, with a laptop, a notebook and a plant softly out of focus behind
work.pose: seated, turned slightly towards the camera with one forearm resting on the desk, a relaxed, confident half-smile, looking into the lens
work.outfit: smart office wear: a crisp light-blue shirt with the collar open
work.light: soft morning daylight from a large window at one side

holiday.scene: on the deck of a sailing boat on a sunny afternoon, with the sea and a hazy coastline softly out of focus behind
holiday.pose: standing at the rail, turned slightly towards the camera, relaxed and at ease with a hint of a smile, looking into the lens
holiday.outfit: a relaxed linen shirt in a light colour with the sleeves rolled
holiday.light: bright, warm afternoon sun with soft shadows

party.scene: on a rooftop terrace at night, with friends chatting out of focus in the background and city lights as warm bokeh
party.pose: standing, holding a glass at chest height, laughing as if mid-conversation, looking towards the lens
party.light: warm string lights overhead and the glow of the city at night

date_night.scene: alone at a candle-lit table in a restaurant courtyard in the evening, with fairy lights as warm bokeh behind and nobody else in the picture
date_night.pose: seated, leaning in a little with one hand resting on the table, a warm, easy smile, looking into the lens
date_night.light: warm candlelight on the face and soft evening ambience

ethnic_vibes.scene: in the courtyard of a heritage haveli in the late afternoon, with carved stone arches softly out of focus behind
ethnic_vibes.pose: standing, turned slightly towards the camera, poised and at ease, looking into the lens

diwali.scene: at a Diwali celebration at home in the evening, with rows of lit diyas and marigold garlands softly out of focus behind
diwali.pose: standing, relaxed, smiling warmly, looking into the lens
diwali.outfit: festive Indian wear in a rich colour
diwali.light: warm golden light from the lamps

sportswear.scene: on a running track beside a park in the early morning, with trees softly out of focus behind
sportswear.pose: standing, catching their breath after a run, energetic and relaxed, looking into the lens
